home.title: Lemon New Tab
home.description: Lemon New Tab is a local-first open-source browser extension with search, quick links, bookmarks, wallpapers, dynamic themes, clock, quotes, import/export, and browser sync.
home.lead: A new tab page arranged for daily use.
home.intro: This is a browser extension for keeping search, favorite sites, bookmarks, wallpapers, and the clock on the page you open most often. Most settings stay in the browser, and there is no separate account to create.
home.featuresIntro: Skip flashy tools and focus on the essentials — doing the basics well is what matters.

featureRows.title: Search
featureRows.text: Use Bing, Google, Baidu, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, custom engines, suggestions, and local search history.

featureRows.title: Quick Links
featureRows.text: Show most-visited sites, or add, pin, group, page, drag, and arrange your own links. Dock and Launchpad layouts are available.

featureRows.title: Bookmarks
featureRows.text: Search, open, edit, delete, and rearrange browser bookmarks directly from the new tab page.

featureRows.title: Wallpapers and Themes
featureRows.text: Use Bing daily images, online image APIs, local images, video wallpapers, and dynamic color extracted from wallpapers.

featureRows.title: Time and Text
featureRows.text: Display clock, date, seconds, lunar calendar, daily poems, quotes, or your own custom lines.

featureRows.title: Backup and Sync
featureRows.text: Import/export settings, or use browser-account sync. There is no separate account system.

home.privacyText: Settings, quick links, wallpapers, and similar data mainly stay in your browser. There is no developer-operated backend for receiving personal data; search suggestions, wallpaper APIs, and browser sync follow your settings and browser permissions.
home.installText: You can also download a build from GitHub Releases.
home.footerNote: Personal open-source project, licensed under AGPL-3.0.
